title: fix(i18n,app-shell): the maker's first sentence promises only what ADR-0112 v1 builds (#8329)
body:
Closes #8329

## What was wrong

The AI build surface's empty state — the **first sentence a new user reads on that page**, sitting above the start chips — opened with:

> Describe an app **or workflow** in plain language — I draft the objects, screens and **automations**, then you review and publish.

Workflows and automations are exactly what ADR-0112 v1 refuses (no flows, actions or schedules), so a user who took the sentence at its word was turned down.

This is the last member of a family whose other three were already fixed:

| Surface | Card | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Five from-scratch start chips | cloud#1984 / objectui#7710 | ✅ |
| Four edit-mode start chips | objectui#7709 | ✅ |
| Model's own closing suggestions | cloud#2020 / cloud#2022 | ✅ |
| **The static line above all of them** | **this PR** | ⬅ |

## What changed

Two strings, **both** on the build agent's surface (`agentEmptyState()` in `AiChatPage.tsx`):

- `console.ai.empty.build.description` — "an app **or workflow** … objects, screens and **automations**" → "an app … objects, screens and **sample data**"
- `console.ai.empty.editApp.description` — "… view or **automation**" → "… view or **dashboard**"

The second one is **not in the issue body** — I found it while tracing the render site. It is the same `isBuildAgent()` branch (edit mode, `?package=`), so it makes the same promise on the same surface.

### ⚠️ All ten packs, not just en/zh

The issue says *"只有 en 与 zh 有这条，其余 8 个语言包走回退"*. That is **not** the case — **every one of the ten packs shipped its own translated violation** (ar/de/es/fr/ja/ko/pt/ru too). A two-language fix would have left eight languages reading the old promise.

The hardcoded `defaultValue` fallbacks in `AiChatPage.tsx` are updated alongside, since a stale fallback silently reinstates the sentence for any pack that loses the key.

## Deliberately NOT changed

The boundary is **v1 AI authoring**, not the word "automation". The platform's manual automation paths are real and stay as they are:

| String | Why it stays |
|---|---|
| `home.build.subtitle` ("design objects, forms, automations and interfaces") | Its card navigates to **`/studio`** — manual authoring, which genuinely does author flows |
| `engine.studio.landing.description` | Studio's own landing copy, same manual path |
| `dataImport.optRunAutomations` ("Run automations & triggers") | Import wizard running *existing* automations at runtime |
| `packagedAutomation.*` | Setup › Packaged automation — operational surface for flows installed packages ship |
| marketplace `automation` category | Taxonomy label |
| approvals / `flowRunner.*` groups | Real runtime features |
| `auth.layout.subhead` ("…data management, workflows, and analytics") | Login-page platform positioning |
| `console.ai.*` `approv` hits (`toolAwaitingApproval`, `planApprove*`) | The **user** approving the AI's plan — not the AI building an approval |

## Tests

New `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/makerEmptyState-v1-scope-8329.test.ts`, built on the 7709 suite's shape (54 tests):

1. Every pack defines both descriptions and both titles, non-empty.
2. Neither description in any pack hits that pack's **own** banned vocabulary — an English-only scan would have declared the five non-Latin packs clean without reading a character of them.
3. **Non-vacuity control**: each pack's banned list is re-run against the two sentences that pack actually retired, and must flag both.
4. A "didn't revert to its own old string" guard, and positive assertions that the replacement names v1 capabilities.

Verified the guard actually bites: reinstating the old zh string fails 3 tests (`expected [ '自动', '流程' ] to deeply equal []`).

## Verification

- `packages/i18n/` — **1090 passed**
- `packages/app-shell/` — **6261 passed**, 1 skipped (649 files)
- `@object-ui/i18n type-check` clean; `app-shell` builds clean (`tsc` passes)
- eslint on changed files: 0 errors
- **End-to-end through the real i18n runtime**: resolved `console.ai.empty.{build,editApp}.description` via `createI18n({lng}) + changeLanguage()` for all ten locales and read back each translated string — not just a read of the pack objects.

⚠️ **Not done: a browser screenshot.** The card's acceptance asks for one from a running environment; this seat verified through the i18n runtime and the component's unit tests instead. If the screenshot is required to close, it still needs to be taken.

## Revert note

When ADR-0112 v2 re-adds flows and actions, **both** sentences come back — same line of the roadmap as the chips. Recorded in the comment beside the keys in `en.ts` and in the test's `RETIRED` map (which holds every pack's original wording).
